object_name: desktop humanoid robot (350 mm, servo-driven shoulders and hips)

parts.name: chest_shell
parts.prompt: Front torso shell of a 350 mm desktop humanoid. Shared frame: Z up from the sole, +Y forward, origin on the centerline. ONE PLA solid, shelled to 2.4 mm wall with internal ribs (smallest bbox dim far exceeds 5x wall). Lofted capsule half occupying y>=0: gently convex chest plate swelling at the pectoral line z=255, width 105 at the shoulders (z=290) tapering to 88 at the waist (z=210) and 96 at the pelvis (z=170); torso spans z=170..300, full torso depth 55 (this half 27.5). Every face crowned/curved, all edges filleted R3 - no flat slab faces. Seam: full-perimeter tongue 1.5 wide x 1.5 deep on the y=0 parting face (location fit 0.15, 0.5 mm lead-in chamfer on the tongue) mating the back shell's groove; 6 M3 bosses Ø4.5 (Ø2.5 pilot, 0.5 mm entry chamfer) at (+/-20,0,298), (+/-30,0,255), (+/-25,0,170); the two z=298 top-deck bosses take brass M3 heat-set inserts (repeated service). Top deck at z=300 carries the neck bearing: Ø8.40 bore, 10 mm land, axis Z through (0,0,300), 0.8 mm lead-in chamfer BOTH entries, with an under-deck pocket capturing the M3x10 retention screw + Ø7 washer and a seat for a 0.2 mm PTFE friction washer on the deck face. Shoulder modules: half-cylinders Ø34 (completed by the back shell), axis X through (+/-x,0,290), extending laterally to open mouths at x=+/-58; each mouth has an external snap groove (0.15 mm interference ridge) for a push-on dome cap. Hip modules: half-cylinders Ø34, axis X through (+/-x,0,180), mouths at x=+/-50 with the same snap groove. MG996R servo bays behind the module mouths: pocket = 40.7 x 19.7 x 42.9 mm body + 0.5 mm air per side, lug seats on the datasheet 49.5 x 10.0 four-hole pattern with M4x12 machine screws into hex-nut pockets (insertion fit 0.15-0.20 at lug seats), shoulder bay local origins (+/-46,0,290) shaft along +/-X, hip bay local origins (+/-44,0,180) shaft along +/-X; each servo drops in outward through its open module mouth before the cap closes. Home-pose swing corridors: nothing of this shell within 5 mm of the arm plane x=+/-73 (z=230..300 band) or the thigh corridor about x=+/-38.

parts.name: back_shell
parts.prompt: Rear torso shell (service door) of the 350 mm humanoid, y<=0 half, ONE PLA solid, 2.4 mm wall. Mirrors the chest loft: curved back plate spanning z=170..300, width 105 at shoulders -> 88 at waist -> 96 at pelvis, half depth 27.5, with a subtle vertical spine crease (a 3 mm deep, R8 cove) down the centerline; all edges filleted R3, no flat faces. Seam: full-perimeter groove 1.5 wide x 1.5 deep on the y=0 face (location fit 0.15) receiving the chest shell's tongue; through-clearance holes Ø3.4 with countersinks at the 6 boss stations (+/-20,0,298), (+/-30,0,255), (+/-25,0,170) so M3x10 screws enter from the back - removing this shell opens the electronics bay. Completes the y<0 halves of the four Ø34 joint-module cylinders at (+/-x,0,290) and (+/-x,0,180). Wiring per route: Ø8 grommet holes through the shoulder-bay inner walls at (+/-40,-15,278); twin 8 x 6 mm printed spine channels moulded inside either side of the spine crease running z=278 down to z=230; 10 x 6 mm slots at z=230 entering the electronics bay (lower back, z=190..230, an inner-face pocket with a bus-board mount: 4x Ø4.5 bosses on a 40 x 30 pattern); Ø8 grommet holes in the pelvis deck at (+/-30,-12,192) for the hip servo leads rising into the same bay.

Shared frame placement: local origin (46,0,290), output shaft along +X, horn face at x=48 on the shoulder axis (axis X through y=0, z=290). parts.name: upper_arm_L
parts.prompt: Left upper arm of the 350 mm humanoid, ONE PLA solid. Shoulder axis = X through (y=0, z=290). Drive end, inboard to outboard along that axis: a drive disc Ø20 x 4 at x=48 that screws to the MG996R horn (2x M2.5 clearance holes Ø2.9 on the Ø14 horn bore circle + central Ø3.4 hole for the M3 servo center screw; central locating counterbore Ø6.25 x 2 seating over the horn hub, 0.5 mm chamfer); a hub barrel Ø12 from x=52 to x=58; then the outboard stub journal Ø6.0 spanning x=58..67 (0.8 mm lead-in chamfer at the tip) that runs in the shoulder dome cap's Ø6.35 x 8 mm bore land, running fit 0.35 - the snapped-on cap traps the drive disc inside the module and is the arm's axial retention. From the hub, a curved yoke arm (elliptical section 12 x 8, swept, R4 blends) sweeps outboard and down to the shell. Shell: tapered lofted ELLIPTICAL shell (never a box), 2.0 mm wall, cross-section 26 wide -> 20 root-to-tip, centerline plane x=+73, spanning z=266 down to z=237, top ring at least 22 mm from the shoulder axis so it clears the Ø34 module by >=5 mm through the full +/-45 deg swing; crisp 1.0 mm annular panel-seam lip at the top (location fit 0.15, 0.5 mm chamfer, 2x internal M3 bosses). Distal end: elbow TONGUE 6 mm thick centered on plane x=73 (x=70..76), rounded profile R10, with a Ø5.35 bore on axis X through (73,0,235), 0.6 mm lead-in chamfer both entries (running fit 0.35 over the Ø5.0 elbow dowel). Home pose: hanging straight down, >=5 mm air to the torso everywhere.
